name: Fontara Legal Hold Notice
description: Fontara Legal's request to place one custodian under a legal hold: the requester, the matter name and ID, the custodian and their email, what must be preserved, the date preservation starts from and the Legal contact. The hold notice itself goes to the custodian for acknowledgement.

welcome.title: Place a legal hold
welcome.text: One request per custodian. The custodian receives the hold notice and must acknowledge it.

fields.label: What must be preserved
fields.description: Systems, mailboxes, files and paper records, and the subjects they concern.

thankYou.title: Hold requested
thankYou.text: The custodian will receive the legal hold notice to acknowledge. Questions go to the Legal contact you named.
